name: ecko-ai-commercial-lab
description: AI-native commercial production lab: GPT-directed storyboards, generated visual assets, code-driven motion, and reproducible MP4 rendering.

scripts.prepare:aurora: npm run audio:aurora && npm run assets:aurora && npm run validate
scripts.prepare:novael: npm run audio:novael && npm run assets:novael && npm run validate
scripts.render:aurora: npm run prepare:aurora && remotion render src/index.ts AuroraColdBrew commercials/aurora-cold-brew/output/aurora-cold-brew-v1-2-render.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p --color-space=bt709 && npm run finalize:aurora
scripts.render:novael: npm run prepare:novael && remotion render src/index.ts NovaelArc commercials/novael-arc/output/novael-arc-v1-2-render.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p --color-space=bt709 && npm run finalize:novael
scripts.test:motion: node scripts/test-motion-math.mjs && node scripts/test-reproducibility.mjs && node scripts/test-novael-qa.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run validate:contract && npm run test:contract && npm run test:v12 && npm run test:audio && npm run test:mastering && npm run test:motion && npm run typecheck
